28BYJ-48 Stepper Internal Geartrain Backlash Mechanics
nodes.rationale: The 64:1 spur gear reduction creates 18-20 steps of backlash hysteresis upon direction change, requiring software hysteresis compensation or anti-backlash gearing.

nodes.label: First-Surface Mirror Physics & Chemical Delamination
nodes.rationale: Standard rear-surface mirrors produce secondary ghost reflections from the front glass boundary; removing the protective backing via chemical paint stripper converts them to front-surface mirrors.

nodes.label: Tangential Non-Linearity and Pincushion Distortion
nodes.rationale: Flat projection surfaces distort angular galvanometer sweeps according to X = L * tan(2*theta); non-linear distortion increases toward field edges, requiring geometric correction or LUT compensation.

nodes.label: Laser Radiation Photobiology & Eye Safety (NOHD)
nodes.rationale: 445nm blue coherent radiation presents extreme retinal photothermal and photochemical hazard; requires OD5+ certified eye protection and enclosed beam path.

nodes.label: Bipolar Driver Migration Trade-off
nodes.rationale: Converting 28BYJ-48 to bipolar with A4988/TMC2208 drivers provides double the running torque and microstepping smooth motion over unipolar Darlington drive.

nodes.label: Dual Stepper Motor & A4988 Driver Test Guide
28BYJ-48 4-Wire Bipolar Conversion Method
nodes.rationale: Severing the central common 5V VCC trace on the motor PCB decouples the two center-tapped coils, turning unipolar motor into true 4-wire bipolar stepper with 2x torque.

nodes.label: A4988 Vref Current Limit Calibration
nodes.rationale: Calibrating Vref reference voltage sets peak coil current according to I_max = V_ref / (8 * R_s), preventing motor overheating and driver thermal shutdown.
